description:
On API boot, start a background goroutine that periodically (configurable interval, default 5 min) queries the Stripe API for recently-paid checkout sessions and cross-checks against local `checkout_sessions` + `subscriptions`. For any paid session without a matching local subscription, write a `payment_anomaly_log` row (type `checkout_subscription_missing`) and attempt re-materialization via the existing `insertOrUpdateSubscription()` path.

Belt-and-suspenders counterpart to fix/lpbs-checkout-webhook-atomicity: catches any failure mode not covered by transactional atomicity (e.g., pre-fix data, deliberately deleted webhook deliveries, missed events while API was down). See Findings 1, 3 and round-2 d1=A decision (in-process goroutine ticker; no external scheduler) of the research conclusion.
name: lpbs-stripe-reconciliation-ticker
title: Add goroutine ticker that reconciles Stripe paid sessions against local subscriptions
